motions_and_votes.description: Approval of highway safety targets for 2026
Adoption of Lexington Regional Transit Asset Condition Targets for Calendar Year 2026

agenda_items.title: Highway Safety Targets for 2026
agenda_items.summary: Discussion on setting highway safety targets for 2026, including fatalities and serious injuries, with a goal of zero by 2050.

agenda_items.title: Lexington Regional Transit Asset Condition Targets for 2026
agenda_items.summary: Discussion on the condition of transit assets, including revenue and non-revenue vehicles, and facilities, with targets set for 2026.

agenda_items.title: Governor's Recommended State Highway Plan
agenda_items.summary: Review and discussion of the Governor's recommended state highway plan and regional highway project priorities, including projects in Fayette and Jessamine counties.

agenda_items.title: Federal Transportation Reauthorization
agenda_items.summary: Discussion on the upcoming expiration of the IIJA and the introduction of the Basics Act, which proposes changes to federal transportation funding and planning.
